title: Inventory QOL
description: A modpack made for the best inventory management experience.
body:
# Inventory QOL 
(Fabric 1.21.x)



**⚡ Fast Inventory Interaction**

Inventory systems in modern Fabric mods focus on speed + automation 
instead of manual dragging.
Instant item transfer between chests / inventory / shulkers
Smart sorting with one click
Saved loadouts (mining, combat, building setups)
Less clicking, more action

**📦 Storage & Item Visibility**

_You get way more control over what’s inside your items:_
Shulker previews directly in tooltips
Chest searching / tracking across storage systems
Container info shown instantly without opening menus


**🔍 Information & Crafting UI**

_The UI becomes a full item database:_
Recipe browser (crafting, smelting, uses)
Modded item support included
Block + entity info overlay when looking at them

**📊 HUD & Hotbar Improvements**

_Everything on screen becomes clearer and more readable:_
Armor durability & potion effects visible in real time
Better item selection feedback in hotbar
Cleaner, less cluttered UI layout


**🧠 Overall Result**

_A system where:_

→ inventory management becomes instant

→ storage becomes searchable

→ information is always visible when needed

→ vanilla gameplay stays unchanged
